dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: No way! What a stroke of luck!

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: These are the materials I'd bought with money out of my own pocket to develop new parts!

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: I had the merchants transport the shipment overland, but the cargo was taken by some unknown monsters in the wilderness... No one knew where it was.

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: It's been giving me a massive headache, so much so that I even thought about taking a few days off to look for the shipment myself. But now the problem's all solved!

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! Thank you so very much!
